title: Use AD account as the unique user identity
goal: Use the AD account field in the Feishu user dictionary as the sole business user identifier across all user-linked reads and writes.
target_user: All Digital Exhibition users and administrators whose records are linked through the Feishu user dictionary.
in_scope: Treat 用户字典.AD账号 as the unique business user key
Store AD account values in user-reference fields of other business tables
Resolve authenticated Feishu identity to an AD account before business queries
Update affected read, write, approval, points, favorites, messages, permissions and tests
out_of_scope: Renaming user-reference fields in non-user tables
Changing Feishu open_id or user_id API semantics
success_metric: All user-linked business operations use AD账号 as their canonical value and the complete Web test/build gates pass.
